This is very informative! The DOWN action changed the symbol in the first position of the pink row. The symbol shifted/rotated - it seems like the symbols in the pink row are cycling. Let me understand this better:
Looking at the changes in the pink row (rows 52-56):
- The symbol at position 1 (col ~15-19) changed
- The pink dots within the symbols shifted positions
It seems like DOWN modifies the symbol at the current cursor position in the pink row. The cursor was at position 1 (col 17) when DOWN was pressed, and the symbol there changed.
Let me also note that the bottom bar at row 63 changed (col 62: 'w' -> 'c'), which is likely a HUD element.
So the mechanics seem to be:
- LEFT/RIGHT: Move the cursor horizontally across the 5 positions
- DOWN: Modify/change the symbol at the current cursor position in the pink row
- UP: Probably does something similar but for the blue row, or reverses the change
Let me test this hypothesis by trying UP and seeing if it reverses the change, and by trying DOWN again to see if it cycles further.
